question: Who won the women's singles title in Australian Open 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Australian tennis player Ashleigh Barty **defeated **American Danielle Collins to win** the **Australian Open women's title on 29 January 2022.**
 
• Barty is the first Australian player to win the Australian Open singles championship since **1978.**
 
• She won the** French Open in 2019 and Wimbledon in 202**1 and has been the no.1 ranked female player in the world for over 100 weeks.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Spain's Rafael Nadal won the Australian Open Men's Singles final on 30 January 2022.
 
• With this victory, Rafael has become the first man to win 21 Grand Slam titles.
 
• He overtook Roger Federer and Novak Djokovic by winning this title.
 
• In tennis, Aslan Karatsev won the men’s singles title at the Sydney Tennis Classic final, to claim his third ATP Tour title.
 
• World number six Rafael Nadal won the men’s singles tennis title at the 2022 Melbourne Summer Set 1.
 
• French tennis player Gael Monfils has won the men’s singles event of the 2022 Adelaide International 1 to claim the 11th ATP title of his career.
 
• The Davis Cup 2021 was won by the Russian Tennis Federation with a 2-0 lead over Croatia in the Davis Cup final in Madrid.
 
• Alexander “Sascha” Zverev has won the fifth ATP title of the season (2021) and 18th overall at the Vienna Open 2021.
